user.title: Ravelli Smart Wi-Fi
user.description: Choose how to find the Wi-Fi module of the stove.

discovery_confirm.title: Ravelli stove found
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add the {model} stove found at {host}?

data_description.host: New IP address or hostname of the Wi-Fi module.

progress.scan: Searching the local network for Wi-Fi modules. This can take up to a minute.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or a hostname.
error.none_found: No module was found on the local network. Enter its address.
error.not_winet: A device answers at this address, but it is not a Ravelli Smart Wi-Fi module.

abort.already_in_progress: The setup of this module is already in progress.
abort.not_winet: The device is not a Ravelli Smart Wi-Fi module.
abort.unsupported_model: Stove model {model} is not supported yet. Ask for it at {issue_url}.
abort.wrong_device: The module at this address is not the one that was configured.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two readings of the stove, from 10 to 300.

cannot_connect.message: The Wi-Fi module of the stove does not answer.

command_refused.message: The Wi-Fi module refused the command.

device_not_found.message: The selected device is not a Ravelli stove that is set up and loaded.

model_mismatch.message: The module now reports stove model {model} instead of model {expected}. Reconfigure the integration.

not_winet.message: The device at the address of this entry is not a Ravelli Smart Wi-Fi module.

register_not_writable.message: Register {register} cannot be written on this stove model.

schedule_end_before_start.message: The end of the program must be later than its start.

schedule_mismatch.message: The module did not store the schedule as it was sent. Check the programs on the module.

schedule_name_characters.message: The program name can only hold unaccented letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation.

schedule_name_length.message: The program name must hold 1 to 15 characters.

schedule_no_time.message: An enabled program needs a start time or an end time.

schedule_no_weekday.message: Select at least one day of the week.

schedule_power_range.message: The power level must be between 1 and 5.

schedule_slot_range.message: The program slot must be between 1 and 6.

schedule_temperature_range.message: The temperature must be between 5 and 40 °C.

schedule_time_step.message: Start and end times must fall on a quarter of an hour.

schedule_unreadable.message: The schedule stored in the stove cannot be read. Check the programs on the page of the module.

temperature_required.message: Give a temperature, or turn the manual mode on.

turn_off_during_ignition.message: The stove is igniting and the flame is not established. Wait before turning it off.

turn_on_in_alarm.message: The stove is in alarm. Turn it off to acknowledge the alarm, then turn it on.

unsupported_model.message: Stove model {model} is not supported yet. Ask for it at {issue_url}.

value_out_of_range.message: Value {value} is outside the allowed range, {minimum} to {maximum}.

delete_schedule_program.name: Delete schedule program
delete_schedule_program.description: Frees one of the six program slots of the stove.

set_schedule_program.name: Set schedule program
set_schedule_program.description: Stores a program in one of the six slots of the stove. The other slots are kept.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the stove follows this program.

end.name: End
end.description: Time at which the stove turns off, on a quarter of an hour. Leave empty for a program that only starts the stove.

manual.name: Manual mode
manual.description: Run at the chosen power without a target temperature.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the program, 1 to 15 characters, without accents.

start.name: Start
start.description: Time at which the stove turns on, on a quarter of an hour. Leave empty for a program that only stops the stove.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature, from 5 to 40 °C. Not needed in manual mode.

weekdays.name: Days
weekdays.description: Days of the week on which the program runs.
